summary: Iteration 75 - CamScanner testing. Fixed critical bug: 'Cannot access stopCamera before initialization' (moved stopCamera useCallback before handleFileInput). Tests 3-6 PASS. Tests 1-2 (Multi-page flow and PDF merge) FAIL due to pages state not being saved correctly when using file input in camera phase.

bug_fixed.root_cause: stopCamera useCallback was defined AFTER handleFileInput which referenced it in its dependency array, causing a temporal dead zone error
bug_fixed.fix: Moved stopCamera definition to line 174 (before handleFileInput at line 179) in DocumentScanner.jsx
bug_fixed.verification: Scanner now opens without errors, all single-image operations work correctly

TEST_1_MULTIPAGE_FULL_FLOW.details: First image uploads and processes correctly. Clicking 'Page suivante' triggers the save but pages.length stays 0. Second image processes but appears as single image (no page strip, no page counter, 'Valider' button instead of 'Terminer').
TEST_1_MULTIPAGE_FULL_FLOW.console_evidence: [Scanner] Fallback mode simple appears after clicking Page suivante - indicates isScanReady() returns false during save
TEST_1_MULTIPAGE_FULL_FLOW.suspected_cause: State synchronization issue between workerReady React state and isScanReady() module function

TEST_2_PDF_MERGE.details: Blocked by TEST_1 failure - cannot reach pages view with 2+ pages to test PDF merge
TEST_2_PDF_MERGE.note: PDF generation code exists and uses jsPDF library

TEST_3_CHAIN_OPERATIONS.details: Upload -> B&W filter (17ms) -> Rotate right (15ms) -> Rotate left (15ms) -> Original filter (17ms) -> Brightness +48 (3ms) -> Crop (22ms) - ALL operations succeed with timing in step log

TEST_4_ALL_BUTTONS_ENABLED.details: All 10 buttons verified ENABLED after image upload: filter-bw, filter-document, filter-original, rotate-left-btn, rotate-right-btn, manual-crop-btn, adjust-toggle-btn, preview-confirm-btn, preview-retake-btn, preview-add-page-btn

TEST_5_STEP_LOG_TIMING.details: All operations show timing in format (Xms): Document détecté (44ms), Filtre Noir & Blanc appliqué (17ms), Rotation droite appliquée (15ms), Luminosité +32 (3ms), Recadrage appliqué (22ms)

TEST_6_SIMPLE_MODE.details: Toggle simple mode works, simple-mode-badge appears, all 5 advanced buttons disabled with opacity-40 class (filter-bw, filter-document, filter-original, manual-crop-btn, adjust-toggle-btn)

critical.issue: Pages not saved when clicking 'Page suivante'. The pages array stays empty after save operation.
critical.root_cause_analysis: When addPageAndContinue() is called, saveAndGetUrl() checks isScanReady() which returns false (module-level 'ready' variable out of sync with React state). This causes it to return processedUrl directly, but the pages state update doesn't persist.
critical.console_log_evidence: [Scanner] Fallback mode simple appears right after clicking Page suivante
critical.suggested_fix: Either sync isScanReady() with workerReady React state, or ensure saveAndGetUrl always returns a valid URL by removing the isScanReady() check (processedUrl is always valid at save time)

minor.issue: DataCloneError: Failed to execute 'postMessage' on 'Worker' - unrelated to scanner
minor.note: This is from a separate OCR worker, not the scanner worker

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Multi-page flow - investigate why pages state doesn't persist after addPageAndContinue()
Consider using workerReady React state in saveAndGetUrl() instead of isScanReady() module function
Or simplify saveAndGetUrl() to always return processedUrl when worker is unavailable
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: stopCamera was defined after handleFileInput causing ReferenceError
ISSUE: isScanReady() module function may be out of sync with workerReady React state during page saves
Individual scanner operations (filter, rotate, crop, adjust) all work correctly with timing
Simple mode toggle works correctly with proper button disabling
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_image_1.jpg (300x200 red) and /tmp/test_image_2.jpg (400x300 blue) for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 fixed the stopCamera initialization bug. Individual scanner features (rotation, filters, crop, brightness) all work. Multi-page flow has a state sync issue - when clicking 'Page suivante', the page isn't saved to the pages array. The console shows '[Scanner] Fallback mode simple' which indicates isScanReady() returns false at save time even though the worker successfully processed images. The workerReady React state and isScanReady() module function may be out of sync.
